demo.intro: i-Write — a trustworthy AI document workbench
demo.kbLocal: Knowledge — local docs: meeting notes, emails, technical documents…
demo.kbRemote: Knowledge — remote docs: OneDrive / SharePoint integration
demo.kbPeople: Knowledge — People Graph: your org chart is part of the knowledge base
demo.peopleExplain: People Graph captures team relationships and domain expertise, giving document generation human context
demo.fourSources: 4 knowledge sources covered: local docs · code repos · remote docs · people graph
demo.useKnowledge: Now let's use this knowledge to generate a document
demo.describeNeed: Describe your document in one sentence
demo.demoRequest: Generate a "Q3 Engineering Team Summary & Business Review" PowerPoint deck
demo.analyzing: AI is analysing the request and drafting an outline…
demo.outlineTimeout: Outline generation timed out — check whether DemoProvider is enabled
demo.outlineReady: Outline ready (5 slides). Click generate once and AI will retrieve knowledge for every slide and write the content (with charts)
demo.streaming: Streaming: AI writes section by section, content appears instantly
demo.docDone: Document generated! i-Write reports 4 quantifiable trust metrics
demo.metricGrounded: Groundedness 0.65 — is the content backed by knowledge-base sources
demo.metricRelevant: Relevance 1.00 — every paragraph is tightly related to the request
demo.metricConflict: Conflict rate 0.25 — AI detected 5 contradictions between sources and handled them
demo.fourDimensions: 4-dimension evaluation: groundedness · relevance · completeness · conflict rate
demo.switchIssues: Switch to "Issues Found" → see the specifics
demo.issueUnsupported: 🔴 Unsupported claims: overall groundedness 65%, some paragraphs lack source support
demo.issueBlocked:
🟢 Conflicts blocked: 5 source contradictions were detected and kept out of the document
For example the two documents disagree on "Q3 team size"
demo.issueBlockedDetail:
Every conflict is labelled with its topic and source documents
so users can trace back to the originals
demo.issuesMeaning: Issues Found = showing users where the document falls short, and why
demo.heatmapOn: Turn on the heatmap → each paragraph coloured by number of sources
demo.heatmapLegend:
Green = cross-verified by multiple sources (high trust)
Yellow = single-source support (medium trust)
Red = AI inference (low trust)
demo.heatmapScroll: Scroll to see how each paragraph is coloured…
demo.heatmapTakeaway: The heatmap makes trust obvious at a glance: you can see which paragraphs need more sources
demo.sourcesSummary:
9 knowledge sources back this document: PRD · product roadmap · technical report · weekly report · monthly report…
Click to jump to the original document
demo.refTrust: Every citation is traceable — users can trace the source of any conclusion
demo.provenanceTree: Provenance tree: which knowledge sources each section cites
demo.clickSection: Click a section → expand the source tree
demo.treeExplain:
The source tree shows which knowledge documents each section cites
Higher scores mean more trustworthy sources
demo.expandSecond: Expand the sources of the second section
demo.dragSources:
Drag knowledge sources to move them between sections
Regenerate a section after changing its citations
demo.dropRelease: …released on the overview section, choose move or copy
demo.confirmMove: Confirm move → sources are reassigned to the target section
demo.sectionChanged: Section citations changed → click "Regenerate this section" to update the content
demo.dragTakeaway:
Dragging sources = precise control over each paragraph's evidence
Click "Regenerate" after changes to update the content
demo.genDoneExport: Document finished — export to Word / PowerPoint / Excel
demo.clickExportPpt: Click export PowerPoint → downloads the PPTX file
demo.exportTakeaway: One-click export, clean formatting, ready to use
demo.recapFlow:
From 9 knowledge sources → RAG retrieval → generated document
→ 4-dimension evaluation → 5 conflicts blocked
demo.recapTagline:
Factual knowledge sources + content generation + evaluation metrics
= trustworthy document generation, i-Write

audit.title: 🔍 AI Document Self-Audit / Stress Test
audit.allFixed: ✅ Fix directions provided for every issue
audit.hint: AI found issues — fix them one by one or all at once
audit.unsupportedDesc: Overall groundedness is only {score}% — some paragraphs lack source support. Consider dragging knowledge sources into the relevant sections and regenerating.
audit.unsupportedSuggestion: Drag knowledge sources onto the low-scoring paragraphs in the Provenance Tree, or add sources and regenerate.
audit.irrelevantSuggestion: Search for this sentence in the document and edit or delete it manually.
audit.uncoveredSuggestion: Add the relevant knowledge sources and regenerate.
audit.lackSourceSuggestion: Search the knowledge base for relevant documents, drag them onto the section and regenerate.
audit.conflictWinner:
AI determined the trustworthy source: {source}
Reason: {reason}
audit.goodDesc: The document is in good shape — no obvious issues found.
